security: Class A, Common Stock, par value $0.0001 per share
footnote_text: Grant of restricted stock units ("RSUs"), each providing for the right to receive one share of Class A common stock, $0.0001 par value per share ("common stock"), of ARKO Petroleum Corp. (the "Company") on a one-for-one basis. The RSUs are immediately vested and provide for the right to receive one share of common stock upon the earlier of (i) the date on which the reporting person's service with the Company is terminated (for whatever reason) and (ii) the date of a change in control of the Company. || The reported number of shares includes 231 shares credited to the reporting person in respect of dividend equivalent rights associated with the underlying awards.
